articles.title: Asian crypto exchanges batten down the hatches as hacks surge: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Asian crypto exchanges are scrambling to tighten security on fears of a wave of potentially AI-assisted hacks, even as regional governments embrace tokenization and stablecoins.

articles.title: Zcash's NU7 Upgrade Goes Live, Recycling 60% of Fees to Fund Future Block Rewards
articles.snippet: The Network Sustainability Mechanism will reissue removed ZEC from 2031 within the 21 million cap, as the community debates its dev fund.

articles.title: US Bank Regulator Issues First AI Framework as Banks Battle Rogue Agents
articles.snippet: The OCC's first examiner guide weighs autonomy and financial harm, and directly addresses outside AI agents—the same risk that recently prompted major banks to restrict customer-account access.

articles.title: US Voters Back AI Data Center Restrictions in At Least 29 Communities
articles.snippet: Voters across the United States backed measures to curb data centers, raising new obstacles for the infrastructure powering AI as electricity bills, water supplies, and public oversight dominate the debate.
